title: optimize cpu request path: reduce serialization, pin thread pools, lower lock contention
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: a subset of production traces show CPU-side latency spikes coming from request serialization, KV cache metadata copies, and default thread pool scheduling on high core-count hosts. This PR introduces targeted optimizations to reduce per-request CPU work and scheduling jitter: 1) move protobuf/JSON serialization off the main request thread into per-socket worker queues to reduce latency tail, 2) introduce a configurable per-socket pinned thread pool for request pre-processing and post-processing (default: one worker per NUMA node), 3) minimize KV cache metadata copies during lookups by introducing a borrow/borrowed-view API and shallow-copy path, 4) reduce contention on the request queue by switching to a sharded lock-free ring for hot paths and fallback mutex for cold paths, 5) add adaptive batching hint propagation so the runtime can avoid unnecessary prep work for single-token requests. Includes microbenchmarks, unit tests, and a perf guide. Checklist: - [x] microbenchmarks and perf numbers - [x] unit tests for new APIs - [x] e2e smoke tests in perf-canary harness - [x] docs/perf notes - [x] feature gate + runtime flag defaults and config docs
commits: Initial refactor: extract serialize_worker and move heavy serialization off hot path
Add per-socket pinned thread pool implementation and config
Introduce KVCache borrow-view API and add shallow-copy path for lookups
Switch request queue to sharded ring buffer with fallback mutex and add metrics
Add adaptive-batching hints and propagate through scheduler
Tests and microbench harness, perf numbers and docs
review_comments: Ethan Kim: Requested that serialization workers avoid copying Protobuf byte strings twice; suggested using zero-copy ByteSpan API where possible.
Maya Patel: Addressed by moving to ByteSpan-backed buffers in commit 3; added notes on safety and lifecycle in runtime/request_path.h.
Lina Rodriguez: Questioned how thread pinning behaves on containerized deployments with CPU pinning; asked for docs and a graceful fallback.
Maya Patel: Added detection for available CPU affinity and fallback to unpinned pools when not allowed; documented in runtime flag docs.
Anton Petrov: Observed a small regression in tail latency on a 4-core test host during initial run; traced to contention in metrics emission; requested batching metric emission.
Maya Patel: Batched metrics emission in commit 5; reran perf-canary and tail improved.
Ethan Kim: Approves after small nits on comments and public API naming are fixed.
Lina Rodriguez: Approved after adding runtime flag to opt out for dedicated customers who manage their own pinning.
release_notes: Reduced CPU-side request latency by up to 35% p95 in high-concurrency workloads; improved tail latency by moving serialization off hot path and adding pinned per-socket thread pools. Config flags: runtime.cpu_pinning.enabled (default true), runtime.serialization.offload.enabled (default true). See docs/perf/2025-11-12-cpu-optimizations.md for numbers and rollout guidance.
